datasets.study_context: Peripheral blood monocytes were enriched by negative magnetic selection in the source study. Cell-group results describe the retained processed object, rather than unselected PBMC composition.

datasets.display_name: Atopic dermatitis and healthy-reference PBMC cohort
datasets.study_context: Mixed atopic dermatitis and healthy-reference PBMC cohort. The 27 labels represent technical libraries; cell-level donor and clinical groups are unassigned.
availability_notes: RNA and antibody measurements were processed separately; all source library identifiers and QC records are preserved.
Cell counts describe QC-retained library-barcode records from the deposited matrices. They are not independently confirmed donors or the published final-cell list.
Cell-type annotation combines reference predictions with RNA and antibody-marker checks; uncertain labels are retained.
CellChat uses eight annotated PBMC populations; unassigned records, provisional nonimmune predictions and groups with fewer than ten cells are excluded.
Pathway scores and predicted communication describe the pooled study cohort; no AD-versus-control or age-group comparison is provided.

RNA.content_description: Normalized RNA, source integer counts aggregated by gene symbol, cell annotations and embeddings; clinical groups unassigned.

ADT.content_description: Separately processed antibody measurements, original integer ADT counts and matched cell metadata; clinical groups unassigned.
